236940365:
Great marketing, but ultimately a casual arcade masquerading as a hardcore simulator.

After nearly 100 hours, I think it’s time to call this product what it actually is. Huge credit to the marketing team for successfully pitching this game as an intricate, high-skill-ceiling simulator with deeply technical suspension tuning. In reality, it's just another forgiving, assistant-heavy arcade game designed to appeal to the broadest possible audience.

To be fair, the vehicle customization works: the game actually responds to suspension adjustments, and tuning your car is genuinely the best part…
